# Operator Health Check

- Time: 2026-03-12 22:51 UTC
- PM2: 12 online, 1 stopped (`whisper`)
- Docker: most containers running; issues on `langfuse_langfuse-web_1` (restarting), `lidaros-frontend-1` (unhealthy), `omiximo-email-automation` (unhealthy)
- Disk: `/` at 69% used (452G / 662G)
- Memory: 11.3 GB used / 27.5 GB total; ~16.3 GB available
- GPU: RTX 4090 healthy, 20.6 GB / 24.6 GB VRAM in use by `VLLM::EngineCore`, GPU util 0% at capture
- OpenClaw gateway: RPC probe OK and listening on 127.0.0.1:18789, but service status reports inactive/stopped; systemd unit appears outdated/non-standard and embeds token
- OpenClaw doctor warnings: Telegram/WhatsApp group allowlists empty, so group messages are currently configured to be silently dropped

## Summary
Host resources are within safe thresholds. Main concerns are service health mismatches: `whisper` stopped, several Docker containers unhealthy/restarting, and OpenClaw gateway service metadata inconsistent with the live endpoint.
